blocks.description: An ISA-18.2 analog alarm over one Double tag: one to four limits, each with a deadband and an on-delay, acknowledged by Ack.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The Double tag watched.

parameters.name: limits
parameters.description: One to four limits, each kind at most once.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Which limit. Configured limits must ascend lo-lo < lo < hi < hi-hi, each at most once.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The limit, in the tag's engineering unit.

parameters.name: deadband
parameters.description: How far back inside the limit the value must come before the alarm clears.

parameters.name: onDelayS
parameters.description: How long the value must stay across before the alarm raises.

blocks.description: An output coil: drives a Bool tag true while a condition is at its normal value and false otherwise, writing on its first scan and on each change.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: The Bool tag watched, and the value that energises the coil.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The Bool tag watched.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The value that means the condition is satisfied.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The Bool tag the coil drives; claim it so nothing else writes it.

blocks.description: The conditions that stop a running thing: any abnormal condition latches Tripped and sends the trip writes once, until Reset.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: The Bool tags whose abnormal value trips the interlock, in report order.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The Bool tag watched.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The value that means the condition is satisfied.

parameters.name: trip
parameters.description: What to command when the interlock trips, once, on the trip scan.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag commanded.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value commanded.

parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: What to command when a reset is accepted, once, on the reset scan.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag commanded.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value commanded.

blocks.description: The conditions something needs before it may start: Ok while every condition is normal, never latched.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: The Bool tags that must be normal, in report order.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The Bool tag watched.

parameters.name: normal
parameters.description: The value that means the condition is satisfied.

blocks.description: A linear sequence of steps, each with entry writes, a transition and an optional timeout, run by Start, Hold, Resume, Abort and Reset.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: The steps, in order. There is no branching and no parallel step.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A short phrase for the step's event message, without a full stop.

parameters.name: writes
parameters.description: What to command on the scan that enters the step.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag commanded.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value commanded.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.description: What ends the step: when a tag compares as asked, or after a delay.

parameters.name: timeoutS
parameters.description: How long the step may run before the sequence faults and sends the abort writes. Omit for no limit.

parameters.name: abort
parameters.description: What to command on an Abort or a step timeout.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag commanded.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value commanded.

blocks.description: An IEC 61131-3 timer over one Bool tag: on-delay (TON), off-delay (TOF) or pulse (TP).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: on-delay raises Q once the input has held true for the preset; off-delay holds Q for the preset after the input falls; pulse gives one preset-long pulse on a rising edge.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The Bool tag timed.

parameters.name: presetS
parameters.description: The delay or pulse length. Zero acts immediately.

objects.description: Ends the step when its clock reaches a delay.

parameters.name: delayS
parameters.description: How long the step runs.

objects.description: Ends the step when a tag compares with a value as asked.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: The tag compared.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: How the tag is compared. A Bool tag allows only == and !=.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: What the tag is compared with.
